items.name: Parse Non-Entity Associated Objects For Property Reference
items.description: If true, then non-entity types are allowed for the ObjectType.PropertyName property reference syntax for all properties. The recommended value for this is True. If this value is changed, the model must be saved and reloaded in order for it to take effect.

items.name: Parse Object Type For Auto-Created Objects As Sibling Properties First
items.description: If true, then the Object Type specified for an Object Instance property set to auto-create objects will first look for the name in its sibling properties, and then in the object types available. If false, it will first look at the object types, and then the sibling properties.

items.name: Parse 'ParentObject' With Fallback To Expression Parent
items.description:
If true, the when parsing an expression involving a 'ParentObject' reference, if the expression fails to compile, then Simio will attempt to compile the expression again with the type of 'ParentObject' to be assumed to be the same type as the parent object of the expression itself. This was the (incorrect) behavior before this option was introduced.

If false, then the type of 'ParentObject' will always be Object.

This should only be set to true for compatibility with older models with expression that rely on older behavior. Otherwise, expression should explicitly specify the types they require. For example, instead of 'ParentObject.MyState' use 'ParentObject.MyType.MyState'.

items.name: 允许非标准的元素/对象名称

items.name: Floating-Point Comparison Mode
items.description:
Specifies how floating-point numbers are compared when evaluating comparison operator expressions (e.g., a == b) within the scope of this model.

Exact - Performs direct ("exact") comparisons using standard operators. This mode may produce unreliable results due to rounding errors and the limited precision of floating-point numbers.

Approximate - Uses a tolerance-based approach to compare numbers, making comparisons more robust to small numerical differences. Two finite numbers a and b are considered approximately equal if:

abs(a - b) <= max(relativeTolerance * max(abs(a), abs(b)), absoluteTolerance)

Warn - Performs direct ("exact") comparisons using standard operators but issues a warning if an approximate comparison would yield a different result. This mode helps identify potential precision-related issues without altering comparison operator behavior.

The following comparison operators are affected by the selected comparison mode:

- Equal to (==)
- Not equal to (!=)
- Less than (<)
- Greater than (>)
- Less than or equal to (<=)
- Greater than or equal to (>=)

stepTypes.name: AddRow
stepTypes.description: The AddRow step may be used to add a new row to an output table. A reference will be set to the newly added row for the executing token or a specified object or element.

properties.name: ObjectType
properties.description: The object or element that will have a reference to the added table row. May be specified as either the executing token, the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object or element reference.

properties.name: ObjectOrElement
properties.description: The specific object or element that will have a reference to the added table row.

properties.name: TableName
properties.description: The name of the output table to add a new row to.

properties.name: KeyColumnValue
properties.description:
The unique key value for this row.

The ability to use output table key columns is available in Simio RPS Edition.

properties.name: AddRowCondition
properties.description: Optional condition that, if specified, must evaluate to true to perform the add row action.

stepTypes.name: AddStock
stepTypes.description: The AddStock step may be used to physically add material stock to a storage bin. Use the RemoveStock step to remove stock from a storage bin.

properties.name: StockAdditions
properties.description: The material stock to add.

properties.name: SaveStockQuantReference
properties.description: Optional state variable to save a reference to each created or updated stock quant.

stepTypes.name: AddStorageLocations
stepTypes.description: The AddStorageLocations step may be used to add a child storage location to a parent storage area. Use the RemoveStorageLocations step to remove a child storage location.

properties.name: StorageLocationAdditions
properties.description: The child storage locations to add.

stepTypes.name: Allocate
stepTypes.description: The Allocate step may be used to attempt capacity allocation of a specified resource to any waiting seize requests.

properties.name: ResourceType
properties.description: The resource object whose capacity units are to be allocated. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: ResourceObject
properties.description: The specific resource object whose capacity units are to be allocated.

properties.name: CancelAllReservationsFirst
properties.description: Indicates whether to first cancel all active reservations (if any) for the resource before attempting to allocate its capacity.

stepTypes.name: Arrive
stepTypes.description: The Arrive step may be used by an entity to notify accepted visit requests that the entity has arrived to the requested destination node.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity object that is notifying accepted visit requests of its arrival. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object that is notifying accepted visit requests of its arrival.

stepTypes.name: Assign
stepTypes.description: The Assign step may be used to assign a new value to a state variable.

properties.name: StateVariableName
properties.description: Name of the state variable that will be assigned a new value.

properties.name: NewValue
properties.description: The new value to assign.

properties.name: Assignments
properties.description: Additional assignments.

stepTypes.name: Batch
stepTypes.description: The Batch step may be used in conjunction with a Batch Logic element to group multiple entities together and then attach the batch members to a parent entity. Use the UnBatch step to later remove batch members from a parent entity.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity that is executing the batch logic. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object that is executing the batch logic.

properties.name: BatchLogicName
properties.description: The name of the Batch Logic element used to execute the batching.

properties.name: BatchQueueType
properties.description: Indicates which queue of the Batch Logic element to insert the entity.

stepTypes.name: Changeover
stepTypes.description: The Changeover step may be used in conjunction with a Changeover Logic element to model a sequence dependent setup at an associated resource.

properties.name: ResourceName
properties.description: The name of the resource object that the changeover applies to.

properties.name: ChangeoverLogicName
properties.description: The name of the Changeover Logic element used to determine any sequence dependent setup times.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The operation entity used to determine any sequence dependent setup times, by comparing its attributes to those of the previous entity. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific operation entity object used to determine any sequence dependent setup times, by comparing its attributes to those of the previous entity.

properties.name: DelayMultiplier
properties.description: Increases or decreases the total setup time due to the changeover by some factor. Specify 2, for example, to mean that the delay is twice as long. Note that this expression is automatically reevaluated if the process is suspended and resumed, potentially adjusting the remaining delay time.

properties.name: SaveSetupTime
properties.description: Optional discrete state variable to store the total incurred setup time due to the changeover.

stepTypes.name: ClearStatistics
stepTypes.description: The ClearStatistics step may be used to clear model statistics.

properties.name: ClearStatisticsType
properties.description: Indicates whether to clear all model statistics or only the statistics for specific objects or elements.

properties.name: ObjectsOrElements
properties.description: The specific objects or elements whose statistics are to be cleared.

stepTypes.name: Consume
stepTypes.description: The Consume step may be used to consume material stock on behalf of a specified owner. The token is held at the Consume step until all of the stock consumption requirements are completed. Use the Reserve or Produce steps to reserve or produce material.

properties.name: OwnerType
properties.description: The object that owns the material stock consumption request. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: OwnerObject
properties.description: The specific object that owns the material stock consumption request.

properties.name: ConsumptionType
properties.description:
The type of material stock consumption.

Material – A single material.

BillOfMaterials – A list of component materials.

BillOfMaterialsGroup – Alternative lists of component materials.

properties.name: MaterialName
properties.description: The name of the material.

properties.name: InventorySiteType
properties.description: Indicates the fixed object that is the inventory location. Applies only to material elements whose Location Based Inventory property is set to True.

properties.name: SiteObjectName
properties.description: The name of the fixed object that is the inventory location.

properties.name: BOMName
properties.description: The name of the bill of materials.

properties.name: BOMGroupName
properties.description: The name of the bill of materials group.

properties.name: Quantity
properties.description: The quantity of the material or parent assembly.

properties.name: LotID
properties.description: Optional string value indicating the lot identifier of the material or parent assembly.

properties.name: RecordMaterialCost
properties.description:
Indicates whether the cost of the consumed material will be recorded (charged) to the cost of the owner object.

NOTE: This property setting applies only to the single material consumption requirement specified using the top-level properties of the Consume step. Any material consumption requirement specified using the Consume Materials (More) repeat group has its own Record Material Cost setting.

properties.name: OnConsumedProcess
properties.description:
Optional process to be executed when material is consumed. The created token's material order detail reference will provide the detail of the material stock consumption.

NOTE: This property setting applies only to the single material stock consumption requirement specified using the top-level properties of the Consume step. Any material stock consumption requirement specified using the Consume Materials (More) repeat group has its own On Consumed Process setting.

properties.name: Materials
properties.description: Additional materials to consume.

properties.name: MustSimultaneouslyConsume
properties.description: Indicates whether all required quantities of materials must be available before any stock can be consumed.

properties.name: ImmediatelyTryConsume
properties.description:
Indicates whether to immediately try consuming the required materials before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system and, if successful, skip the inventory allocation queues.

Setting this property to False will first insert the material stock consumption request into the inventory allocation queues. An evaluation of those queues will then be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

properties.name: ConsumeOperationMaterials
properties.description: Indicates whether to consume the material requirements specified for the owner entity's current operation activity.

stepTypes.name: Create
stepTypes.description: The Create step may be used to create new entity objects of a specified type, create copies of an existing entity, or to create new tokens that reference existing objects. New tokens associated with the created or referenced objects will exit the 'Created' exit point of the step.

properties.name: CreateType
properties.description: The creation method. If creating copies of an existing entity, then the original entity object to copy may be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: OriginalEntityObject
properties.description: The specific original entity object to copy.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The type of entity objects to create. If left unspecified and creating copies, then the same type as the original entity being copied will be assumed.

properties.name: TokenAssociatedObject
properties.description: The primary object reference associated with the new token(s). If left unspecified, then the associated object reference of the original token executing the Create step will be assumed.

properties.name: TokenContextObject
properties.description: The secondary object reference associated with the new token(s). If left unspecified, then the context object reference of the original token executing the Create step will be assumed.

properties.name: NumberToCreate
properties.description: The number of entity objects or tokens to create. May be specified as an expression truncated to integer.

properties.name: StockRequirements
properties.description: Material stock putaway or removal requirements for each created entity.

properties.name: SaveCreatedEntityReference
properties.description: Optional entity reference state variable to save a reference to the created entity. Note that if the number of entities created is greater than one, then the saved reference will be to the last created entity.

properties.name: TokenWaitAction
properties.description:
The wait action to be taken by the token arriving to the Create step.

If the action is ‘NoWait’, then the execution of all new tokens associated with the created or referenced objects will be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as an early priority event. The original token will then immediately exit the step.

If the action is 'NewTokensExitFirst', then all new tokens associated with the created or referenced objects will exit the step first before the original token exits.

If the action is 'WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted', then the original token will wait until the processing of all new tokens associated with the created or referenced objects has been completed before exiting the step.

stepTypes.name: Decide
stepTypes.description: The Decide step may be used to control the flow of a token through process logic. The arriving token exits either the 'True' or 'False' exit point based on the specified probability or condition.

properties.name: DecideType
properties.description: Indicates whether the decision is based on a probability or condition.

properties.name: ConditionOrProbability
properties.description: The decision condition or probability specified as an expression.  If a condition then enter the logical condition. If a probability then enter the chance of selecting 'True' as a value between 0.0 (0%) and 1.0 (100%).

properties.name: RandomNumberStream
properties.description: The random number stream to be used if the decision type is probabilistic.

stepTypes.name: Delay
stepTypes.description: The Delay step may be used to delay a process token for a specified amount of time or until a specified end time.

properties.name: DelayType
properties.description:
The type of delay.

ForTime - Delay for a specified Delay Time.

UntilTime - Delay until a specified Delay End Time.

NOTE: Delaying until a specified Delay End Time ‘t’ is equivalent to delaying for a specified Delay Time ‘Math.Max(t – Run.TimeNow, 0.0)’. Either approach may be used interchangeably.

properties.name: DelayTime
properties.description:
The amount of time to delay.

NOTE: The keyword 'Math.Epsilon' may be used to schedule the end of the delay on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event. The token will continue processing without delay once all normal priority events scheduled for the same simulation time have been processed.

properties.name: DelayEndTime
properties.description:
The end time of the delay.

NOTE: A Delay End Time specified earlier than or equal to the current simulation time will result in the delay being zero.

properties.name: DelayMultiplier
properties.description: A multiplier value used to scale the delay time. Specify 2, for example, to make the delay twice as long. Note that this expression is automatically re-evaluated if the process is suspended and resumed, potentially adjusting the remaining delay time.

properties.name: Interruptible
properties.description: Indicates whether the delay can be interrupted using the Interrupt step.

stepTypes.name: Destroy
stepTypes.description: The Destroy step may be used to destroy an entity object.

properties.name: DestroyType
properties.description: The entity object to destroy. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object to destroy.

properties.name: RecordEntityStatistics
properties.description: Indicates whether or not to record time in system and accrued cost statistics for the destroyed entity.

stepTypes.name: Disengage
stepTypes.description: The Disengage step may be used within a link object's logic to unlock a traveling entity's location from a position on the link. Use the Engage step to engage an entity's location to a position on a link.

properties.name: EntityMovementRate
properties.description: The new movement rate of the disengaged entity on the link.

stepTypes.name: Dropoff
stepTypes.description: The Dropoff step may be used to attempt a transporter dropoff of a riding entity into a node. Use the Pickup step to attempt a transporter pickup of an entity.

properties.name: TransporterType
properties.description: The transporter object that is to perform the dropoff. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: TransporterObject
properties.description: The specific transporter object that is to perform the dropoff.

properties.name: NodeName
properties.description: The name of the node that is the dropoff location. If left unspecified, and the transporter is currently at a node, then defaults to that node.

properties.name: UnloadTime
properties.description: A delay required for unloading a rider from the transporter.

properties.name: FailIfBlocked
properties.description: Indicates whether to fail (balk) the dropoff attempt if the entity cannot immediately transfer into the desired location due to the location being full. If the dropoff attempt fails, then the arriving token will immediately exit the 'Failed' exit point of the Dropoff step.

exits.name: The token exits the step from this exit point if an entity is not dropped off.

stepTypes.name: EndActivity
stepTypes.description: The EndActivity step may be used to end the current operation activity for an entity. Refer to the Operation and Activity elements to define an operation and its activities.

exits.name: The token exits the step from this exit point if the next batch for the entity is still to be processed.

stepTypes.name: EndOperation
stepTypes.description: The EndOperation step may be used to end the current operation for an entity. Refer to the Operation element to define an operation.

exits.name: The token exits the step from this exit point if the operation is not completed within the operation's maximum makespan constraint.

stepTypes.name: EndRun
stepTypes.description: The EndRun step may be used to set the ending time of the simulation run to the current time. This will cause the run to end once all simulation events scheduled for the current time have been processed.

stepTypes.name: EndTransfer
stepTypes.description: The EndTransfer step may be used to indicate that an entity has completed transfer into a location (refer to the Transfer step to initiate a transfer). The step also fires the entity's Transferred event.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity object that is ending the transfer. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object that is ending the transfer.

stepTypes.name: Engage
stepTypes.description: The Engage step may be used within a link object's logic to lock a traveling entity's location to a position on the link. The method used to align the entity on the link is determined by the link's EntityAlignment property. Use the Disengage step to disengage an entity's location from a position on a link.

properties.name: MinimumCellsBeforeEngaging
properties.description: Applies only if the entity is engaging a link with fixed cell interval spacing. Specifies a minimum number of cell boundaries that must first pass the entity's position before the entity is allowed to engage.

stepTypes.name: Execute
stepTypes.description: The Execute step may be used to execute a specified process.

properties.name: ProcessName
properties.description: The name of the process to execute.

properties.name: TokenWaitAction
properties.description:
The wait action to be taken by the token arriving to the Execute step.

If the action is 'NoWait', then execution of the specified process will be scheduled on the simulation's current events calendar as an early priority event. The token will then immediately exit the step.

properties.name: CopyTableRowReferencesFromCreatedToken
properties.displayName: Copy Table Row References From Created Token
properties.description: Indicates whether to copy the created token's table row references to the waiting token after the the created token has finished processing.

stepTypes.name: Fail
stepTypes.description: The Fail step may be used to start a downtime occurrence of a specified failure type. Use the Repair step to end a downtime occurrence.

properties.name: FailureName
properties.description: The type of failure to start.

properties.name: TokenWaitAction
properties.description: The wait action to be taken by the token arriving to the Fail step.

stepTypes.name: Find
stepTypes.description:
The Find step may be used to search the value of an expression over a specified range of one or more index variables. The expression will typically involve array variables (vectors or multi-dimensional arrays) or functions that index into collections.

Search types supported by the Find step include finding the index variable value(s) that satisfy the specified expression as a logical condition, as well as searches that minimize or maximize the expression. The arriving token exits either the 'Found' or 'NotFound' exit point of the step based on whether or not a successful result was found by the search.

properties.name: IndexVariableName
properties.description: The name of the state variable used to hold the index value.

properties.name: StartingIndex
properties.description: The integer start limit of the index range to be searched.

properties.name: EndingIndex
properties.description: The integer end limit of the index range to be searched.

properties.name: IndexVariables
properties.description:
Additional index variables.

If multiple index variables are specified, then the search range will be conducted as a nested indexed search in the order that the index variables are listed.

properties.name: SearchType
properties.description:
The objective of the search.

If the search type is 'Condition', then the search will stop on the first index result within the search range that satisfies the logical condition specified in the Search Expression property.

If the search type is 'MinimizeExpression' or 'MaximizeExpression', then the search will find the index result within the search range that minimizes or maximizes the expression specified in the Search Expression property.

properties.name: SearchExpression
properties.description:
The search condition or expression that uses the specified index variables.

If the search type is 'Condition' and an index result satisfying the search condition is found, then the value 'True' will be stored into the ReturnValue state of the executing token. Otherwise, the value 'False' will be stored.

If the search type is 'MinimizeExpression' or 'MaximizeExpression', then the minimum or maximum expression value found will be stored into the ReturnValue state of the executing token.

stepTypes.name: Fire
stepTypes.description: The Fire step may be used to fire a specified event.

properties.name: EventName
properties.description: The name of the event to fire.

stepTypes.name: Insert
stepTypes.description: The Insert step may be used to insert an object into a specified queue. Refer to the Storage element to define a custom queue in the model.

properties.name: QueueStateName
properties.description: The name of the queue state into which the object will be inserted.

properties.name: ObjectType
properties.description: The object to be inserted into the queue. May be specified as the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: Object
properties.description: The specific object to be inserted into the queue.

properties.name: RankPlacement
properties.description: If specified, overrides the queue state's ranking rule. If the queue's ranking rule is FirstInFirstOut or LastInFirstOut, then this expression is interpreted as a specific rank index at which to place the inserted object. Otherwise, if the queue's ranking rule is SmallestValueFirst or LargestValueFirst, then this expression is interpreted as the inserted object's ranking value.

stepTypes.name: Interrupt
stepTypes.description:
The Interrupt step may be used to interrupt process delays. A token delaying at a process Delay step is considered a candidate for interruption if the 'Interruptible' property of the Delay step evaluates to 'True'. 

The Interrupt step may also be used to create new tokens that are associated with, or point to, the objects whose process delays were interrupted. These tokens will exit the 'Interrupted' exit point of the step.

properties.name: ProcessName
properties.description: The name of the process with interruptible delay activity.

properties.name: SelectionRule
properties.description: The rule used to select which process delay(s) to interrupt from one or more candidates.

properties.name: InterruptedProcessAction
properties.description:
Indicates how an interrupted process delay is to be handled once the new token created by the Interrupt step to handle the interruption occurrence ends its processing.

If the action is 'EndProcess', then the processing of the interrupted token will be ended.

If the action is 'ResumeDelay', then the interrupted token will resume delaying at the Delay step for its remaining delay time.

If the action is 'EndDelay', then the interrupted token will end its delay and exit the Delay step.

properties.name: ProcessNames
properties.description: The names of additional processes with interruptible delay activity.

properties.name: Limit
properties.description: The maximum number of process delay activities to interrupt.

properties.name: SaveNumberInterrupted
properties.description: Optional discrete state variable to store the number of process delay activities that were interrupted. This state variable assignment will be applied to the original token executing the Interrupt step.

properties.name: SaveRemainingTime
properties.description: Optional discrete state variable to store an interrupted process delay's remaining time. This state variable assignment will be applied to each token exiting the 'Interrupted' exit point of the Interrupt step.

exits.name: A new token associated with an interrupted item will exit from this exit point.

stepTypes.name: Move
stepTypes.description: The Move step may be used to request a move from one or more moveable resources that have been seized by a specified owner. The executing token is held at the Move step until all of the requested movements are completed.

properties.name: OwnerType
properties.description: The object that owns the seized resources to be moved. Specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: OwnerObject
properties.description: The specific object that owns the seized resources to be moved.

properties.name: ResourceMoveRequests
properties.description: The resources that will be requested to move.

stepTypes.name: Notify
stepTypes.description: The Notify step may be used to output a user-defined trace, warning, or error message.

properties.name: NotificationType
properties.description: The context under which the message will be displayed. If specified as 'Trace' and model trace is enabled, then the message will be displayed in the trace window.  If specified as 'Warning', then the message will be handled according to the model's warning settings.  If specified as 'Error', then the model will immediately terminate with the provided message.

properties.name: MessageHeading
properties.description: Optional text used as the heading for the displayed message.  May be specified either as a string expression or as a literal string of characters enclosed in double quotes.

properties.name: MessageContent
properties.description: Optional text used as the content for the displayed message.  May be specified either as a string expression or as a literal string of characters enclosed in double quotes.

properties.name: NotifyCondition
properties.description: Optional condition that, if specified, must evaluate to true for the message to be displayed to the user.

stepTypes.name: NotifyConstraint
stepTypes.description: The NotifyConstraint step may be used to add a custom log entry to the model's constraint log. To enable constraint logging during a simulation run, select Enable Interactive Logging in Run, Advanced Options.

properties.name: NotificationType
properties.description: Indicates the type of notification sent to the model's constraint log. If specified as 'StartConstraint', then a new constraint log entry will be created. If specified as 'EndConstraint', then the end timestamp will be logged for the active constraint log entry whose fields match the same entity, constraint type, and constraining object or element.

properties.name: ConstraintType
properties.description: The value of the Constraint Type field in the constraint log entry. May be specified as an expression that evaluates to a string.

properties.name: ConstrainingObjectOrElement
properties.description: The constraining object or element.  Determines the values of the Constraint Item Id, Constraint Item, and Constraint Description fields in the constraint log entry.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity object that is being constrained. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object that is being constrained.

stepTypes.name: Park
stepTypes.description: The Park step may be used to transfer an entity object from its current location into the parking station of a node. Use the UnPark step to unpark an entity.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity object to be parked. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object to be parked.

properties.name: NodeName
properties.description: The name of the node at which the entity will be parked. Defaults to the entity's current node or, if not at a node, then the first node found in the system.

properties.name: TokenWaitAction
properties.description: The wait action to be taken by the token arriving to the Park step.

exits.name: The token exits the step from this exit point if the park attempt fails.

stepTypes.name: Pickup
stepTypes.description: The Pickup step may be used to attempt a transporter pickup of an entity waiting in the ride pickup queue of a node. Use the Dropoff step to attempt a transporter dropoff of an entity.

properties.name: TransporterType
properties.description: The transporter object that is to perform the pickup. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: TransporterObject
properties.description: The specific transporter object that is to perform the pickup.

properties.name: NodeName
properties.description: The name of the node that is the pickup location. If left unspecified, and the transporter is currently at a node, then defaults to that node.

properties.name: SelectionGoal
properties.description: The goal used to rank pickup preference when selecting from multiple candidates.

properties.name: LoadTime
properties.description: A delay required for loading a rider onto the transporter.

exits.name: The token exits the step from this exit point if an entity is not picked up.

stepTypes.name: PlanVisit
stepTypes.description:
The PlanVisit step may be used to have an entity object search for and accept a not yet reserved visit request in the system. Possible visit requests may include pickup requests initiated at Ride steps (applicable to transporter entities) as well as move requests initiated at Seize or Move steps (applicable to resource enabled entities). 

The SelectVisit step can be later used to have an entity actually set its current destination node to an accepted visit location.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity object that is searching the system for a visit request. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object that is searching the system for a visit request.

properties.name: SelectionGoal
properties.description: The goal used to rank visit destination preference when selecting from multiple candidates.

exits.name: The token exits the step from this exit point if a visit request is not accepted.

stepTypes.name: Produce
stepTypes.description: The Produce step may be used to produce material stock on behalf of a specified owner. Use the Reserve or Consume steps to reserve or consume material.

properties.name: OwnerType
properties.description: The object that owns the material stock production request. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: OwnerObject
properties.description: The specific object that owns the material stock production request.

properties.name: ProductionType
properties.description:
The type of material stock production.

Material – A single material.

BillOfMaterials – A list of component materials.

BillOfMaterialsGroup – Alternative lists of component materials.

properties.name: MaterialName
properties.description: The name of the material.

properties.name: InventorySiteType
properties.description: Indicates the fixed object that is the inventory location. Applies only to material elements whose Location Based Inventory property is set to True.

properties.name: SiteObjectName
properties.description: The name of the fixed object that is the inventory location.

properties.name: BOMName
properties.description: The name of the bill of materials.

properties.name: BOMGroupName
properties.description: The name of the bill of materials group.

properties.name: Quantity
properties.description: The quantity of the material or parent assembly.

properties.name: LotID
properties.description: Optional string value indicating the lot identifier of the material of parent assembly.

properties.name: ProductionDelayTime
properties.description:
Optional delay time before producing the material and adding it to inventory.

NOTE: This property has been deprecated. Use a Delay step instead. To edit a deprecated property, go to File->Settings->GUI->Display Deprecated Properties In Properties Window and change that setting to True.

properties.name: RecordAsOrderReceivedCondition
properties.description:
Indicates whether to record the produced material as a received order.

NOTE: This property setting applies only to the single material production requirement specified using the top-level properties of the Produce step. Any material production requirement specified using the Produce Materials (More) repeat group has its own Record As Order Received If setting.

properties.name: OnProducedProcess
properties.description:
Optional process to be executed when material is produced.

NOTE: This property setting applies only to the single material stock production requirement specified using the top-level properties of the Produce step. Any material production requirement specified using the Produce Materials (More) repeat group has its own On Produced Process setting.

properties.name: Materials
properties.description: Additional materials to produce.

properties.name: ImmediatelyTryAllocate
properties.description:
Indicates whether to immediately try allocating the produced materal to waiting material stock consumption requests before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system.

Setting this property to False will skip immediate allocation. Instead, an evaluation of the inventory allocation queues will be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

properties.name: ProduceOperationMaterials
properties.description: Indicates whether to produce the materials specified for the owner entity's current operation activity.

stepTypes.name: Release
stepTypes.description: The Release step may be used to release capacity of one or more resources that have been seized by a specified owner. Use the Seize step to seize resources.

properties.name: OwnerType
properties.description: The object that owns the seized resources to be released. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: OwnerObject
properties.description: The specific object that owns the seized resources to be released.

properties.name: ResourceReleases
properties.description: The resources to be released.

properties.name: SeizedResourcesFilterType
properties.description:
Filter type applied to the owner object’s list of currently seized resources before attempting the resource releases.

Token – Filters to only include seized resource items that are linked to a given token’s execution.

Task - Filters to only include seized resource items that are linked to a given task's execution.

properties.name: SeizedResourcesFilterToken
properties.description: Expression returning a reference to the process token that the seized resource items must be linked to.

properties.name: SeizedResourcesFilterTask
properties.description: Expression returning a reference to the task that the seized resource items must be linked to.

properties.name: UseStrictListReferencing
properties.description: If a resource release requirement is ‘FromList’, indicates whether the release can include only resources that have been seized from the same specified list. The default setting is False and if left unchanged then list membership will be sufficient to include a resource.

properties.name: ReleaseOperationResources
properties.description:
Indicates whether to release the resource requirements specified for the owner entity's current operation activity.

NOTE: This property has been deprecated. Use the Resource Releases repeat group instead.

properties.name: ImmediatelyTryAllocate
properties.description:
Indicates whether to immediately try allocating the released resource capacity to waiting seize requests before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system.

Setting this property to False will skip immediate allocation. Instead, an evaluation of the resource allocation queues will be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

stepTypes.name: Remove
stepTypes.description: The Remove step may be used to remove an object from a specified queue. A new token associated with the removed object will exit the 'Removed' exit point of the step. Refer to the Storage element to define a custom queue in the model.

properties.name: QueueStateName
properties.description: The name of the queue state from which the object will be removed.

properties.name: ObjectType
properties.description: The object to be removed from the queue. May be specified as the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, a specific object reference, or as the object at a specified queue rank.

properties.name: Object
properties.description: The specific object to be removed from the queue.

properties.name: RankIndex
properties.description: Expression truncated to integer specifying the rank of the object in the queue to be removed.

properties.name: TokenWaitAction
properties.description:
The wait action to be taken by the token arriving to the Remove step.

If the action is ‘NoWait’, then the execution of the new token associated with the removed object will be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as an early priority event. The original token will then immediately exit the step.

If the action is 'NewTokenExitsFirst', then the new token associated with the removed object will exit the step first before the original token exits.

If the action is 'WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted', then the original token will wait until the processing of the new token associated with the removed object has been completed before exiting the step.

properties.name: SaveNumberRemoved
properties.description: Optional discrete state variable to save the total number of items removed from the collection.

stepTypes.name: RemoveRows
stepTypes.description: The RemoveRows step may be used to remove all existing rows from an output table.

properties.name: TableName
properties.description: The name of the output table to remove rows from.

properties.name: RemovalType
properties.description: Indicates whether to remove all rows from the specified output table or only a specific row.

properties.name: ObjectType
properties.description: The object or element that has a reference to the table row to be removed. May be specified as either the executing token, the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object or element reference.

properties.name: ObjectOrElement
properties.description: The specific object or element that has a reference to the table row to be removed.

stepTypes.name: RemoveStock
stepTypes.description: The RemoveStock step may be used to physically remove material stock from a storage bin. Use the AddStock step to add stock to a storage bin.

properties.name: StockRemovals
properties.description: The material stock to remove.

properties.name: SaveStockQuantReference
properties.description: Optional state variable to save a reference to each removed or updated stock quant.

stepTypes.name: RemoveStorageLocations
stepTypes.description: The RemoveStorageLocations step may be used to remove a child storage location from a parent storage area. Use the AddStorageLocations step to add a child storage location.

properties.name: StorageLocationRemovals
properties.description: The child storage locations to remove.

stepTypes.name: Repair
stepTypes.description: The Repair step may be used to end a downtime occurrence of a specified failure type. Use the Fail step to start a downtime occurrence.

properties.name: FailureName
properties.description: The name of the failure to end.

properties.name: TokenWaitAction
properties.description: The wait action to be taken by the token arriving to the Repair step.

stepTypes.name: Reserve
stepTypes.description: The Reserve step may be used to reserve resources or material stock for possible later use by a specified owner. Other objects will be unable to use a reserved item unless the reservation is cancelled. Use the UnReserve step to cancel a resource or material stock reservation.

properties.name: OwnerType
properties.description: The object that will own the reservation. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: OwnerObject
properties.description: The specific object that will own the reservation.

properties.name: ReservationType
properties.description: Indicates whether to create a resource or material reservation.

properties.name: ResourceName
properties.description: The name of the resource object to reserve.

properties.name: NumberCapacityUnits
properties.description: The number of capacity units of the resource to reserve.

properties.name: MaterialConsumptionType
properties.description:
The type of material consumption.

Material – A single material.

BillOfMaterials – A list of component materials.

BillOfMaterialsGroup – Alternative lists of component materials.

properties.name: MaterialName
properties.description: The name of the material.

properties.name: InventorySiteType
properties.description: Indicates the fixed object that is the inventory location. Applies only to material elements whose Location Based Inventory property is set to True.

properties.name: InventorySiteObjectName
properties.description: The name of the fixed object that is the inventory location.

properties.name: BOMName
properties.description: The name of the bill of materials.

properties.name: BOMGroupName
properties.description: The name of the bill of materials group.

properties.name: MaterialQuantity
properties.description: The quantity of the material or parent assembly.

properties.name: MaterialLotID
properties.description: Optional string value indicating the lot identifier of the material or parent assembly.

properties.name: ReservationTimeout
properties.description: An optional wait time before automatically cancelling the reservation.

properties.name: Reservations
properties.description: Additional reservations.

stepTypes.name: ReserveBins
stepTypes.description: The ReserveBins step may be used to reserve storage bin capacity for an entity's material stock putaway requirements. Use the ReserveStock step to reserve storage bin stock for material stock removal requirements.

properties.name: SelectionRules
properties.description: The selection rules used to reserve storage bin capacity for the specified entity's material stock putaway requirements.

properties.name: SaveStockReservationReference
properties.description: Optional state variable to save a reference to each created stock putaway reservation.

properties.name: SavePhaseNumber
properties.description: Optional state variable to save the phase number of the current search phase.

properties.name: SaveStartingStorageAreaReference
properties.description: Optional state variable to save a reference to the starting storage area of the current search phase.

properties.name: MinimumStockReservationQuantity
properties.description:
The lower limit on the quantity of material in a created stock putaway reservation.

In the expression, use the syntax Stock.Requirement.[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the stock requirement (e.g., Stock.Requirement.Material).

NOTE: This expression is reevaluated at the beginning of each search phase. Use the Save Phase Number and Save Starting Storage Area Reference properties to determine the current search phase, applying a state variable approach.

properties.name: MaximumStockReservationQuantity
properties.description:
The upper limit on the quantity of material in a created stock putaway reservation.

In the expression, use the syntax Stock.Requirement.[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the stock requirement (e.g., Stock.Requirement.Material).

NOTE: This expression is reevaluated at the beginning of each search phase. Use the Save Phase Number and Save Starting Storage Area Reference properties to determine the current search phase, applying a state variable approach.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description:
The entity containing the material stock putaway requirements.

May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

Refer to the Create step to add material stock putaway or removal requirements to a created entity.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity containing the material stock putaway requirements.

stepTypes.name: ReserveStock
stepTypes.description: The ReserveStock step may be used to reserve storage bin stock for an entity's material stock removal requirements. Use the ReserveBins step to reserve storage bin capacity for material stock putaway requirements.

properties.name: SelectionRules
properties.description: The selection rules used to reserve storage bin stock for the specified entity's material stock removal requirements.

properties.name: SaveStockReservationReference
properties.description: Optional state variable to save a reference to each created stock removal reservation.

properties.name: SavePhaseNumber
properties.description: Optional state variable to save the phase number of the current search phase.

properties.name: SaveStartingStorageAreaReference
properties.description: Optional state variable to save a reference to the starting storage area of the current search phase.

properties.name: MinimumStockReservationQuantity
properties.description:
The lower limit on the quantity of material in a created stock removal reservation.

In the expression, use the syntax Stock.Requirement.[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the stock requirement (e.g., Stock.Requirement.Material).

NOTE: This expression is reevaluated at the beginning of each search phase. Use the Save Phase Number and Save Starting Storage Area Reference properties to determine the current search phase, applying a state variable approach.

properties.name: MaximumStockReservationQuantity
properties.description:
The upper limit on the quantity of material in a created stock removal reservation.

In the expression, use the syntax Stock.Requirement.[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the stock requirement (e.g., Stock.Requirement.Material).

NOTE: This expression is reevaluated at the beginning of each search phase. Use the Save Phase Number and Save Starting Storage Area Reference properties to determine the current search phase, applying a state variable approach.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description:
The entity containing the material stock removal requirements.

May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

Refer to the Create step to add material stock putaway or removal requirements to a created entity.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity containing the material stock removal requirements.

stepTypes.name: RestartRun
stepTypes.description: The RestartRun step may be used to set the ending time of the simulation run to the current time. This will cause the run to end once all simulation events scheduled for the current time have been processed. Interactive mode will require the next run to be started manually. Otherwise, a new run will then be automatically started, treated as a run restart for the same scenario replication instance if running in experiment mode.

stepTypes.name: Resume
stepTypes.description: The Resume step may be used to resume model behavior that has been suspended using the Suspend step.

properties.name: ResumeType
properties.description: The type of behavior or logic to resume.

properties.name: ProcessName
properties.description: The name of the process to resume.

properties.name: TokenMatchCondition
properties.description:
Optional match condition used to filter the tokens executing the process. Only tokens currently in process that satisfy this condition will be resumed.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[TokenClass].[Attribute] or Candidate.[TokenAssociatedObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of either the candidate process tokens themselves or the objects associated with those process tokens (e.g., Candidate.Token.TimeInProcess or Candidate.Entity.TimeInSystem).

properties.name: ObjectType
properties.description: The object whose movement capability is to be resumed. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: Object
properties.description: The specific object whose movement capability is to be resumed.

properties.name: FlowRegulatorName
properties.description: The name of the regulator whose flow capability is to be resumed.

properties.name: BatchLogicName
properties.description: The name of the Batch Logic element to resume.

properties.name: ResumeActions
properties.description: Additional resume actions.

stepTypes.name: Ride
stepTypes.description: The Ride step may be used to initiate a transporter ride request for an entity object at a node.

properties.name: TransporterType
properties.description: The method for specifying the transporter object to ride.

properties.name: TransporterName
properties.description: The name of the transporter object to ride.

properties.name: TransporterListName
properties.description: The name of the transporter list from which to select the transporter object to ride.

properties.name: ReservationMethod
properties.description:
The type of reservation method used to select a transporter object to ride.

Reserve Closest - Reserve the transporter that is closest to the entity's current node. The rule used to break ties is the specified selection goal.

Reserve Best - Reserve the transporter using the specified selection goal. The rule used to break ties is the transporter that is closest to the entity's current node.

First Available At Location - Can only select a transporter that is already located at the entity's current node. The rule used to break ties is the specified selection goal.

properties.name: SelectionGoal
properties.description: The rule used in conjunction with the specified reservation method to select a transporter object from multiple candidates.

properties.name: SelectionValueExpression
properties.description:
The expression used to get the value for each candidate transporter.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[TransporterClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate transporter objects (e.g., Candidate.Transporter.RideStation.Capacity).

properties.name: SelectionCondition
properties.description:
Optional condition evaluated for each candidate transporter that must be true for the transporter to be selected.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[TransporterClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate transporter objects (e.g., Candidate.Transporter.RideStation.Capacity).

properties.name: TokenWaitAction
properties.description: The wait action to be taken by the token arriving to the Ride step.

stepTypes.name: Route
stepTypes.description: The Route step may be used in conjunction with a Routing Group element to route an entity to a location selected from a list of possible destination nodes. The executing token is held at the Route step until a destination is assigned.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity to be routed. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object to be routed.

properties.name: RoutingGroupName
properties.description: The name of the Routing Group element that will be used to route the entity to a location selected from a list of possible destination nodes.

properties.name: SelectionGoal
properties.description: The goal used to select a destination if there are multiple candidates available in the list of possible destination nodes.

properties.name: SelectionValueExpression
properties.description:
The expression used to get the value for each candidate destination node.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[NodeClass].[Attribute] or Candidate.[NodeAssociatedObjectClass].[Attribute] to evaluate attributes of either the candidate destination nodes themselves or the objects associated with those candidate nodes (e.g., Candidate.Node.AssociatedStation.Capacity or Candidate.Server.Capacity).

properties.name: SourceNode
properties.description: Optional node whose location will be used for the ‘distance to’ calculation instead of the current location of the routing entity.

properties.name: BlockedDestinationRule
properties.description:
The rule used to manage destination selection if there are one or more candidates in the list of possible destination nodes that have no space available.

If the rule is 'Select Any', then whether or not a destination is blocked will be ignored.

If the rule is 'Select Available Only', then only a destination that is not currently blocked may be assigned, and if all possible destinations are blocked then the executing token will be held at the Route step until a destination becomes available.

If the rule is 'Prefer Available', then a destination that is not currently blocked will be preferred, but if all possible destinations are blocked then the best destination per the selection goal will still be immediately assigned.

properties.name: SelectionCondition
properties.description:
Optional condition evaluated for each candidate destination node that must be true for the node to be selected.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[NodeClass].[Attribute] or Candidate.[NodeAssociatedObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of either the candidate destination nodes themselves or the objects associated with those candidate nodes (e.g., Candidate.Node.AssociatedStation.Capacity or Candidate.Server.Capacity).

properties.name: SelectionConditions
properties.description: Additional selection conditions. Multiple conditions are treated as AND conditions, so all conditions must be true for the node to be selected.

properties.name: RouteConstraintLogic
properties.description: Constraint logic used to enforce additional constraints on the entity's route request.

properties.name: RandomNumberStream
properties.description: The random number stream to be used if the destination selection goal is 'Random'.

properties.name: RequiredMaterials
properties.description:
Additional material availability constraints enforced on the entity's route request.

NOTE: This repeat group has been deprecated. Use the Route Constraint Logic property instead. To edit the deprecated repeat group, go to File -> Settings -> GUI and set the Display Deprecated Properties in Properties Window value to True.

stepTypes.name: Scan
stepTypes.description: The Scan step may be used to hold a process token until a specified condition is true. The logical condition may be specified as any arbitrary expression.

properties.name: Condition
properties.description: Logical condition that must be true for a token to pass through the step.

stepTypes.name: Search
stepTypes.description: The Search step may be used to search a collection of objects or table rows. New tokens associated with any found items will exit the 'Found' exit point of the step.

properties.name: CollectionType
properties.description: The type of collection to be searched.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity population to be searched.

properties.name: ObjectInstanceName
properties.description: The name of the object instance to be searched.

properties.name: ObjectType
properties.description: The type of object to search.

properties.name: ObjectListName
properties.description: The name of the object list to be searched.

properties.name: QueueStateName
properties.description: The name of the queue state to be searched.

properties.name: TableName
properties.description: The name of the table to be searched.

properties.name: SearchRelatedRowsOnly
properties.description: If the specified Table Name has foreign key references to other tables, then indicates whether to search only the related rows in the table. Otherwise if this property is set to False, then the search will consider all rows in the table regardless of any primary key-foreign key relationships.

properties.name: OwnerType
properties.description: The object that owns the seized resources to be searched. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: OwnerObject
properties.description: The specific object that owns the seized resources to be searched.

properties.name: NodeListName
properties.description: The name of the node list to be searched.

properties.name: TransporterListName
properties.description: The name of the transporter list to be searched.

properties.name: NodeName
properties.description: The name of the node whose collection of drawn inbound or outbound links is to be searched.

properties.name: NetworkName
properties.description: The name of the network whose collection of link members is to be searched.

properties.name: ResourceType
properties.description: The resource object whose list of current owners or reservations is to be searched. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: ResourceObject
properties.description: The specific resource object whose list of current owners or reservations is to be searched.

properties.name: SearchType
properties.description:
The direction or objective of the search.

If the search type is 'MinimizeExpression' or 'MaximizeExpression', then the collection will be searched for the items that minimize or maximize the sum of the specified Search Expression.

If the search type is ‘ForwardSumExpression’ or ‘BackwardSumExpression’, then the collection will be searched in the forward or backward direction while also summing the specified Search Expression.

properties.name: MatchCondition
properties.description:
Optional match condition used to filter the items searched. Only items that satisfy this condition will be selected.

If searching a collection of objects, then in the expression use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate objects (e.g., Candidate.Entity.Priority).

properties.name: SearchExpression
properties.description:
The expression to be evaluated for each item in the searched collection and summed.

If searching a collection of objects, then in the expression use the syntax Candidate.[ObjectClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate objects (e.g., Candidate.Entity.Priority).

properties.name: SaveSearchExpressionSum
properties.description: Optional discrete state variable to save the sum of the specified Search Expression for the item(s) found by the search.

properties.name: Limit
properties.description: The maximum number of items to find.

properties.name: StartingIndex
properties.description: The one-based starting index of the search. If defaulted, then the starting index is the first item in the collection if a forward search or the last item in the collection if a backward search.

properties.name: EndingIndex
properties.description: The one-based ending index of the search. If defaulted, then the ending index is the last item in the collection if a forward search or the first item in the collection if a backward search.

properties.name: SaveIndexFound
properties.description: Optional discrete state variable to save the one-based index of the last item in the collection found by the search.

properties.name: SaveNumberFound
properties.description: Optional discrete state variable to save the total number of items in the collection found by the search.

properties.name: CopyOverTableRowReferences
properties.description: Indicates whether to copy table row references over from the original token executing the Search step to new tokens associated with found items.

properties.name: SetTableRowConflictResolution
properties.description:
The conflict resolution type when setting the table row reference for a new token associated with a found row in the searched table. Applies only if the Copy Over Table Row References property is set to True (due to the potential for conflicts with the table row references copied over from the original token executing the Search step).

Abort - The table row references copied over from the original token will be kept and no reference set to the found row in the searched table.

Replace - The table row references copied over from the original token will be discarded, replaced by a reference to the found row in the searched table.

properties.name: TokenWaitAction
properties.description:
The wait action to be taken by the token arriving to the Search step.

If the action is ‘NoWait’, then the execution of all new tokens associated with found items will be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as an early priority event. The original token will then immediately exit the step.

If the action is 'NewTokensExitFirst', then all new tokens associated with found items will exit the step first before the original token exits.

If the action is 'WaitUntilNewTokenProcessingCompleted', then the original token will wait until the processing of all new tokens associated with found items has been completed before exiting the step.

stepTypes.name: Seize
stepTypes.description: The Seize step may be used to seize capacity of one or more resources for a specified owner. The executing token is held at the Seize step until all of the seize requirements are completed. Use the Release step to release resources.

properties.name: OwnerType
properties.description: The object that will own the seized resources. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: OwnerObject
properties.description: The specific object that will own the seized resources.

properties.name: ResourceSeizes
properties.description: The resources to be seized.

properties.name: MustSimultaneouslySeize
properties.description: If multiple resources are required, indicates whether all of the resources must be available before any can be seized.

properties.name: SeizedResourcesFilterType
properties.description:
If a resource seize requirement is quantity type 'Deficient', indicates the filter type applied to the owner object’s list of currently seized resources before calculating the deficient quantity still needed.

Token – Filters to only include seized resource items that are linked to a given token’s execution.

Task - Filters to only include seized resource items that are linked to a given task's execution.

properties.name: SeizedResourcesFilterToken
properties.description: Expression returning a reference to the process token that the seized resource items must be linked to.

properties.name: SeizedResourcesFilterTask
properties.description: Expression returning a reference to the task that the seized resource items must be linked to.

properties.name: UseStrictListReferencing
properties.description: If a resource seize requirement is ‘FromList’ and quantity type ‘Deficient’, indicates whether the deficient quantity calculation counts only already seized resources that have been seized from the same specified list. The default setting is False and if left unchanged then list membership will be sufficient to count an already seized resource.

properties.name: SeizeConstraintLogic
properties.description: Constraint logic used to enforce additional constraints on the seize request.

properties.name: ImmediatelyTrySeize
properties.description:
Indicates whether to immediately try seizing the resource requirements before the execution of any other simulation logic in the system and, if successful, skip the resource allocation queues.

Setting this property to False will first insert the seize request into the resource allocation queues. An evaluation of those queues will then be scheduled on the simulation’s current events calendar as a late priority event.

properties.name: SeizeOperationResources
properties.description:
Indicates whether to seize the resource requirements specified for the owner entity's current operation activity.

NOTE: This property has been deprecated. Use the Resource Seizes repeat group instead.

stepTypes.name: SelectDropoff
stepTypes.description: The SelectDropoff step may be used to set the destination node of a transporter object to the drop-off location of a riding entity.

properties.name: TransporterType
properties.description: The transporter object that is selecting a drop-off destination. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: TransporterObject
properties.description: The specific transporter object that is selecting a drop-off destination.

properties.name: SelectionGoal
properties.description: The goal used to rank drop-off destination preference when selecting from multiple candidates.

exits.name: The token exits the step from this exit point if the step fails to set a dropoff destination.

stepTypes.name: SelectVisit
stepTypes.description:
The SelectVisit step may be used to set the destination node of an entity object to the location of an accepted visit request. Possible visit requests may include pickup requests initiated at Ride steps (applicable to transporter entities) as well as move requests initiated at Seize or Move steps (applicable to resource enabled entities).  

To have an entity first search for and accept a not yet reserved visit request in the system, use the PlanVisit step.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity object that is selecting the destination of an accepted visit request. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object that is selecting the destination of an accepted visit request.

properties.name: SelectionGoal
properties.description: The goal used to rank visit destination preference when selecting a visit from multiple candidates.

exits.name: The token exits the step from this exit point if a visit destination is not selected.

stepTypes.name: SetNetwork
stepTypes.description: The SetNetwork step may be used to set the network of links used by an entity object to travel between node locations.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity object whose network value is to be set. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object whose network value is to be set.

properties.name: NewNetworkName
properties.description: The new network value to set.

stepTypes.name: SetNode
stepTypes.description: The SetNode step may be used to set the destination node of an entity object.

properties.name: EntityType
properties.description: The entity object whose destination node value is to be set. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: EntityObject
properties.description: The specific entity object whose destination node value is to be set.

properties.name: DestinationType
properties.description: The method used to assign the destination node. 'By Sequence' requires that the entity object has been assigned a sequence table. The destination node value will be set to the next destination in the sequence.

properties.name: NodeName
properties.description: The name of the specific node object that is the destination.

properties.name: NodeIDNumber
properties.description: The integer ID number of the node object that is the destination.

properties.name: MatchCondition
properties.description:
The first node object found that satisfies this optional match condition will be selected as the destination, starting the search in the facility window where the entity is currently located.

In the expression, use the syntax Candidate.[NodeClass].[Attribute] to reference an attribute of the candidate destination nodes (e.g., Candidate.Node.RidePickupQueue).

properties.name: RouteConstraintLogic
properties.description: Constraint logic used to enforce additional constraints on the entity’s request to be assigned a destination.

properties.name: AutoClearIfVisitDifferentNode
properties.displayName: Auto Clear If Visit Different Node
properties.description: Indicates whether to automatically clear the assigned destination node if for any reason the entity visits a different node beforehand.

stepTypes.name: SetRow
stepTypes.description: The SetRow step may be used to set a table row reference for the executing token or a specified object or element. The index number of the row is specified by the Row Number property. Use the UnSetRow step to remove table row references.

properties.name: TableName
properties.description: The name of the table that contains the row to reference.

properties.name: RowNumber
properties.description: The one-based index number of the row in the table. If left unspecified then defaults to either the first row or before the first row if a sequence table.

properties.name: ObjectType
properties.description: The object or element for which to set the specified table row reference. May be specified as either the executing token, the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object or element reference.

properties.name: ObjectOrElement
properties.description: The specific object or element for which to set the specified table row reference.

properties.name: SetRowCondition
properties.description: Optional condition that, if specified, must evaluate to true to set the table row reference for the specified object or element.

properties.name: UnsetAllRowsFirst
properties.description: Indicates whether to first remove all table row references previously set for the object or element before setting the new row reference.

properties.name: FallbackToBestRelatedRows
properties.description:
When enabled, if the object or element being resolved has no related rows in the specified table, the resolver attempts to find suitable related rows from other objects in the SetRow step's execution context, such as the parent object, token, or entity type instance.
This allows row references to be resolved even when a direct relationship is not available.

If related rows can be found, the specified Row Number is interpreted as the row at that index in the related rows.

If no related rows can be found, the specified Row Number is interpreted as an absolute row number in the table.

When disabled, only rows directly related to the target object or element are considered.

stepTypes.name: SetTable
stepTypes.description: The SetRow step may be used to set a table row reference for the executing token or a specified object or element. The index number of the row is specified by the Row Number property. Use the UnSetRow step to remove table row references.

properties.name: TableName
properties.description: The name of the table that contains the row to reference.

properties.name: RowNumber
properties.description: The one-based index number of the row in the table. If left unspecified then defaults to either the first row or before the first row if a sequence table.

properties.name: ObjectType
properties.description: The object or element for which to set the specified table row reference. May be specified as either the executing token, the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object or element reference.

properties.name: ObjectOrElement
properties.description: The specific object or element for which to set the specified table row reference.

properties.name: SetRowCondition
properties.description: Optional condition that, if specified, must evaluate to true to set the table row reference for the specified object or element.

properties.name: UnsetAllRowsFirst
properties.description: Indicates whether to first remove all table row references previously set for the object or element before setting the new row reference.

properties.name: FallbackToBestRelatedRows
properties.description:
When enabled, if the object or element being resolved has no related rows in the specified table, the resolver attempts to find suitable related rows from other objects in the SetRow step's execution context, such as the parent object, token, or entity type instance.
This allows row references to be resolved even when a direct relationship is not available.

If related rows can be found, the specified Row Number is interpreted as the row at that index in the related rows.

If no related rows can be found, the specified Row Number is interpreted as an absolute row number in the table.

When disabled, only rows directly related to the target object or element are considered.

stepTypes.name: SetWorkSchedule
stepTypes.description: The SetWorkSchedule step may be used to assign a new work schedule to a resource object.

properties.name: ResourceType
properties.description: The resource object to assign the new work schedule. May be specified as either the object associated with the executing token, the parent object, or as a specific object reference.

properties.name: ResourceObject
properties.description: The specific resource object to assign the new work schedule.

properties.name: NewWorkScheduleName
properties.description: The name of the new work schedule to assign.
